description: This file defines a React component for a Wishlist page in an e-commerce application, connecting to Redux for state management and rendering different components based on wishlist data and loading state.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: A React component that displays the user's wishlist, fetching data on mount and conditionally rendering wishlist items, loading indicator, or not found message.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches the wishlist data when the component is mounted.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the wishlist page, showing loading indicator, wishlist items, or not found message based on state.
